locator: Original Table II GR00T N1.5 task-FT + RAGu 1 candidate
trainingData: RAGu keeps pretrained GR00T-N1.5/π0.5 weights frozen during evaluation; source DROID demos transformed into Cartesian trajectories and guide flow action sampling without weight update. Baselines may use distinct previously finetuned checkpoints.
evaluationNotes: Five GR-1 humanoid RoboCasa tabletop tasks 25 episodes each; pretrained base and task-finetuned checkpoints must not mix. Source Table II shows some negative task deltas; 1 vs 100 demonstrations separated.
